name: Badlands National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed only in developed areas and on roads, not on trails or in the backcountry.
summary: Pets are allowed only in developed areas and on roads, not on trails or in the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Pets are prohibited from hiking trails, public buildings (visitor centers), and backcountry areas, including the Sage Creek Wilderness and areas with prairie dog colonies.
Leashed pets are allowed on park roads including back country dirt roads.

dogRules.text: Allowed only in developed areas such as campgrounds and picnic areas, and on roads.
Not on trails, in buildings, in the Sage Creek Wilderness or prairie dog towns.
Leashed dogs may walk the backcountry dirt roads.
Trails on the neighboring Buffalo Gap National Grassland allow pets.
